node.statement: First degree-two comparison. Contractivity of the outer Phi_n gives ||P3-P4||<=||Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y)-Delta_n(XY)|| ||Delta_n Z||. Lem-routef-degree-two-estimate applies because eta<=rho_3<=rho_2 and bounds the first factor by C_2 eta||X||||Y||; UCP contractivity of Delta bounds the second by ||Z||. Hence ||P3-P4||<=C_2 eta||X||||Y||||Z||.
